title: Show migration progress with indicatif
summary: Put a ProgressBar on a migration loop that runs silent for ten minutes, then fix the missing {msg} slot and log lines that break the bar.

turns.user: migrate runs like 10 min with zero output, cant tell if its stuck or working. added indicatif, give me a bar

assistant.body: Sure! The row count is known up front, so rows.len() goes into ProgressBar::new. ProgressStyle::with_template sets the look. A typo in the template comes back at run time as a TemplateError, and ? hands it to the caller. Each finished row calls inc(1), and finish_with_message stops the bar and leaves a message behind. {eta} is the estimated time left, which is exactly what you were missing.

turns.user: bar works. but the final copied X rows never shows. also dont stop everything on one broken email, skip it and tell me which one

assistant.body: Apologies, my previous template had no {msg} in it. finish_with_message swaps the message and stops the bar, so with no slot for it nothing appears. Broken rows are now matched and skipped without counting them. Note: calling eprintln! directly would print in the middle of the bar and garble it, and bar.println prints nothing at all when stderr is not a terminal. bar.suspend hides the bar, runs the closure, and redraws, so the line survives in both cases.
